label: D2 after choosing a1 and reaching S1 by a common transition (gated by trial number and policy)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and essentially only when the agent chose a1 and the common transition took it to S1. The predicate (phase==D2)&(action==1)&(common==1) on its own has recall 1.00 and mass recall 1.00, but precision is only 0.39: the feature is silent on most a1->S1 common D2 steps. It never fires at D1 or GO, on a2, on S2, or on rare transitions. Two observed factors pick out which of those steps it fires on. (1) Episode position: the firing rate falls steeply late in the episode and is about 0 from trial 90 on, so ep_trial<80 raises F1 to 0.63. (2) The model policy logit at that step (choice < 2.78), i.e. the agent is not strongly committed to a1. The largest activations come when a1 is a switch away from a run of a2 choices while S2 is the good state, so an a1 choice that goes against the agent current preference gives the biggest response. The full predicate reaches dev F1 0.70 with mass recall 0.96. The remaining false positives are a1->S1 common steps that do not differ in any recorded variable, which suggests the feature reads graded hidden-state content. No future variables are used: action and common are both observed at D2.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 2 (9 = most a1) (+5.88), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (+5.23), phase=D2 & this=a1 S1 (+4.97), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+4.93), in_action=1 (+3.43), phase=D2 & last=a1 S2 r (+3.43). Lower it: common=0 (-4.55), choice_bin=decile 8 (9 = most a1) (-4.14), in_action=2 (-4.12), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 8 (9 = most a1) (-4.12).
